nom: BLK/OPL Even True PHA + BHA Exfoliating Toner

segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin found the toner went on tacky, pilled with other products, and left skin dry even after moisturizer.

concerns.spots: One reviewer reports it fades dark spots and considers this a bonus benefit alongside BHA acne control; another switching from an original soap-type product says it does not fade blemishes for her skin.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer says the product keeps breakouts at bay and layers well under other actives including retinol; another says it does not work for blemishes/fading on her skin, and a third (combination, acne-prone) did not find it helpful and returned to a different toner.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer with combination skin found it left her skin dry even after applying moisturizer, describing a tacky application and pilling; other reviewers instead describe the finish as fresh with no residue.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers who compare it favorably to Paula's Choice describe it as gentle and safe enough for both AM and PM use without irritation.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under serums and retinol
Value versus Paula's Choice and Glow Recipe
Formula change from original version disliked

extraits.texte: I have combination acne prone skin. I've been using Glow Recipe's PHA + BHA toner for a few years & loved it. I bought this toner as a possible more affordable alternative to the Glow Recipe toner. I've been using this toner consistently for about a month & I'm not a fan. It goes on tacky & leaves my skin dry even after applying moisturizer afterward. Plus, I noticed that there's a lot of pilling when I use it. I don't know if it's user error or if this doesn't play well with my other products. I'll switch back to Glow Recipe or find another similar toner.

extraits.titre: Great Quality Dupe for Paula's Choice
extraits.texte: This product should have 5 ⭐. I have gone thru 4 Bottles since Nov 2022. It's keeping breakouts at bay, moisturizes, layers well under serums (even retinol) with no piling. Gentle + Safe enough to use AM + PM. Excellent product Black Opal! The influencers + beauty blogs/vlogs are sleeping on this Toner + the Booster.

I disagree with the other review saying it's a Paula's dupe.....it's better. It's just as effective but also fades dark spots and doesn't have the oily texture Paula's has. Other exfoliants do better for dark spots but the PHA works well enough that I think of it as a bonus since I primarily use BHAs for acne control.

I used this product first, then tried Paula's choice, and the clear winner is this one. I find the Paula's choice left a film on my skin, while the BLK/OPL left my skin feeling fresh. Lot's of benefits and I just like that there is no residue left behind.
I like the original soap, this new soap does not work for my skin, it does fade the blemishes.

I love this soap. It has great results. I ordered it over a month ago and never heard anymore about my order, even after inquiry at the site. To my knowledge if the product is not available, I have received no refund.

reserve: Only seven reviews are available and most do not specify skin type, so segment-level conclusions beyond combination skin are thin.
